v: strI kf--hiMsAyAm iY striyAM NIz । kaRwakArivfkze rAjani॰ । tasyAH aRwakAcitatvena hiMsAsADanatvAt rogahiMsAkArakatvAdvA taTAtvam ।
m: कारी f. N. of a plant (= कारिका, कार्या &c.), L.
कारीरादि m. pl. N. of a family, JaimUp.

v: strI kaM jalamfcCati f--vic kAraM sajalameGamIrayati Ira--aR upa॰ sa॰ gO॰ NIz । varzahetO izwaBede । “varzakAmezwiH kArIrI” “tasyAM prati tyaM cArumaDvaramIqe agniM svavasaM namoBiriti DAryye” ASva॰ SrO॰ 2 । 13 । 1 । 2 । “varzakAmasya kArIrI nAma izwiH kAryyA । tasyAM--kArIryyAm । atra bahudEvatyAyA AmnAnAt anyadA iyameva kArorI ekadEbatyA Bavati tasyAmapi prApaRArTaM tasyAM grahaRamiti” nArA॰ । ArabDAyAM kArIryyAM kftArdDAyAM varzaRe sati sA samApanIyA na veti sandehe kAtyA॰ SrO॰ 1 । 2 । 22 sU॰ nirRRItaM yaTA “dfzwe tatparimARam” kftArdDAyAmizwO varzaRe dfzwe sati tatparimARameva karmma karttavyaM yatparimARamadfzWe varzaRe kriyate । na tu vfzwO dfzwAyAM kimapyanyUnaM kftArdDaM parityAjyamiti । na ca varzaRaM tatra tasyA izweH PalaM, kintu kAlasbaBAvAt pratibanDakApagamAcca svayaM pravfttam ityASayaH” saM॰ vyA॰ । ataeva jEmininA 6, 2, 13, karmaRi ArabDe PalecCArAhitye, kaTaYcit PalaprAptO ca ArabDasya kAmyakarmmaRaH samApyatvamuktaM yaTA “prakramAttu niyujyetAramBasya nimittatvAditi” vyAKyAtaM cedaM SavarasvAminA yaTA “prajAkAmo yajeta, grAmakAmo yajeta”--ityevamAdi karma samAmnAyate । tatra sandehaH--kiM prakrAntaM niyogataH samApanIyam, utecCayA kAryyaM heyaM vA?--iti kutaH? evaM prAptaM?--niyogataH parisamApayitavyam--iti । kutaH? evaM hi SrUyate,--idaMkAmo yajeta--iti, evaM tasya AKyAtasya arTam upadiSanti, ‘upakramapraBfti apavargaparyantam Aha--iti, upakramAdAraBya yAvat parisamAptiH--ityetAvAn vyApAraviSezaH tasya arTaH, na yaTA pAkaH tyAgaH--iti । tatra hi pAkasattAmAtraM nirddiSyate na AraBya parisamApayitavyam । evaM ca AKyAtATEM lOkikA api pratipadyante, tatra na AramBe puruzaprayatnaH nodyate--iti gamyate । yato noditaM na niyogata AraBante, niyogataH punaH parisamApayanti, tena noBe AramBaparisamAptI SabdArTaH kintarhi?--parisamAptiH SabdArTaH parisamAptyA'rTaprAptatvAt AramBasya । tasmAt parisamAptiH SabdArTaH--qati gamyate । sA cet SabdArTaH, sA karttavyatayA nodyate, AramBe nAsti karttavyatAvacanaM’ tena na niyogata AramBaH, niyogatastu parisamAptiH । tena upakrAnte karmaRi yadi vIyAt PalecCA, avApnoti vA PalaM, tasyAmapyavasTAyAM, karttavyameva upakrAntasya parisamApanam । nanu aTino yo'rTaH so'tra karttavyatayocyate’ । nEtadevaM, vAkyArTo hi sa Bavati, yAgasya tu karttavyatA SrutyA gamyate । tasmAt grAmakAmeRa yAga ArabDaH parisamApanIyaH grAmAdikAmanAvacanaM nimittatvena tadA Bavati nimitte ca utpanne yat karttavyam--ityucyate, tadvinazwe'pi nimitte karttavyam, na hi tadvinazwam anutpannaM Bavati, utpattiSca nimittaM na BAvaH tasmAt vItAyAmapi PalecCAyAm upakrAntaM parisamApayitavyama । kriyAyA hi nimittam AramBaH so'zi parisamApteH” iti । kArIrIzwiM prakftTa SrUyate ca । “yadi varzettAvatyeva juhuyAt” “kArIrImanuvfzwiH” si॰ kO॰ ।
m: कारीरी (ई), f. (scil. इष्टि) ‘connected with the fruit of the plant Capparis aphylla’, a sacrifice in which this fruit is used, MaitrS.; Kāṭh. &c.

v: na॰ karIrasyAvayavaH kARqaM Basma vA palASA॰ aY । 1 vaMSasya kARqe 2 vaMSaBasmani ca ।
m: कारीर mfn. (g. पलाशादि) made of the shoots of reed, Lalit.; Pāṇ. iv, 3, 135, Kāś.
a: कारीर — a. [करीर-अञ्] Made of the shoots of reed or bamboo.

m: कारीष mfn. (fr. कर्˚), produced from or coming from dung, Suśr.
कारीष n. a heap of dung, L.
a: कारीषं — [करीषाणां समूहः अण्] A heap of dried cowdung.

v: tri॰ kArIzasyeva ganDo'sya itsamA॰ । SuzkagomayasaMGaganDayukte striyAM zyaN cAp । kArIzaganDyA tasyAH tatpuruze putrapatyoH paravoH saMprasA॰ dIrGaSca । kArIzaganDIputraH kArIzaganDIpatiH । evaM paramakArIzaganDIputraH । upasarjjane tu na, atikArIzaganDyApatiH । banDuSabdepare tu vahuvrIhO taTA vA, kArIzaganDyAbanDuH kArIzaganDIbanDuH । evaM kOmudaganDyASabdasyApi saMprasAraRadIrGO ।
